components.version: 14.44.35211 or newer, installed by the user from Microsoft's redistributable
components.license: Microsoft Software License Terms of the Visual C++ Redistributable (accepted by the user at install)
components.source: Python 3.12.10 installation; PySide6 and NumPy wheels
components.obligations: BLT redistributes none of Microsoft's runtime files (Microsoft limits redistribution to licensed Visual Studio users). Setup requires Microsoft's own Visual C++ Redistributable (x64), downloaded by the user from Microsoft or supplied by the user for offline installs, and verifies its Microsoft signature before running it. The program checks again before rendering. The one file NumPy imports under a hash-renamed name (msvcp140-<hash>.dll) is created at install time as a copy of the PC's own msvcp140.dll: a copy of a file the user already has, not a redistribution.
components.notes: Enforced by build: packaging/runtime_copies.py fails the build if any Visual C++ runtime file is in the package, and inventory.py fails on unowned files. The installer's prerequisite flow is tested silently (missing runtime stops Setup, nothing installed); its dialogs have not been exercised on a PC that really lacks the runtime (clean-machine gate).
